content.value: An airline agrees to charter planes for a group. The group needs at least 160 first class seats and at least 300 tourist class seats. The airline must use at least two of its model 314 planes which have 20 first class and 30 tourist class seats. The airline will also use some of its model 535 planes which have 20 first class and 60 tourist class seats. Each flight of a model 314 plane costs the company TK. 1 lacs and each flight of a model 535 plane costs TK. 1.5 lacs. Formulate the problem as a linear programming model to find the number of each type plane should be used to minimize the flight cost?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
